caption: The drawing features two main scenes set against a flat, mustard yellow background with a decorative gray border framing the composition. On the left side, a seated female figure in a striped pink and white dress with a bow in her hair holds a staff decorated with a ribbon. A horned sheep or goat with patches of pink stands next to her, while green foliage with pink flowers arches over the figures, creating a partial enclosure. The ground below them is shaded with pink, green, black, and white markings, and small white and pink flowers appear among the greenery. To the right of this scene is another grouping, consisting of three animals resembling sheep or goats, including one lying down in the foreground with pink shading and two standing behind, one of which is elevated on a stone block. This grouping is surrounded by green trees and plants, some with pink and white flowers. Both scenes are integrated by the similar stylized vegetative elements, and the overall color palette includes pink, green, white, and black on the yellow background.
title: Bandbox Design
